desc:
Site speed optimization for ecommerce SEO makes your pages load faster through lighter images, cleaner code and fewer slow apps. Ecom Swift LLC tests your key pages, fixes what weighs them down and shows you the scores before and after.

## Why does site speed matter for an online store?

Site speed matters because shoppers leave pages that take too long to appear, and search engines take page experience into account. A slow product page loses the visitor before they see the photo, price or buy button. That visitor was already paid for, whether through search work or advertising.

Speed problems hide well. The store owner usually browses on a fast connection with the page already cached, while customers use phones on ordinary mobile data.

## What makes stores slow

Most slow stores share a short list of causes. Photos are uploaded at camera size and shrunk only on screen. Apps add scripts to every page, including pages where they do nothing. Fonts and icon sets load in full when only a few characters are used. Theme code carries styles and features the store never turned on.

Each cause is small, but they stack. Together they push the page past the point where a shopper waits.

## How faster pages affect results

A faster page shows its content sooner, so more visitors stay long enough to look at a product. They scroll further, view more pages and reach checkout more often. On mobile, where connections vary, the effect is greater.

For search, speed is one of several signals, and strong content can still do well on a slower page. Speed supports your other work rather than replacing it. We measure with standard tools, show you real before and after scores, and do not promise a perfect score or a higher position, since many other factors apply.

## What a speed pass includes

- Testing of your key pages on mobile and desktop.
- Image compression and correct sizing for each place they appear.
- Lazy loading for images below the first screen.
- Font loading improved, with unused weights removed.
- A review of installed apps and the scripts they add.
- Slow or duplicate apps trimmed or replaced where a lighter option exists.
- Unused theme code and styles removed carefully.
- Third party scripts delayed where it is safe to do so.
- Notes on Core Web Vitals, the standard measures of loading, response and layout shift.
- A re-test and short report.

## How we do it

We choose the pages that matter most, usually the home page, a collection page and a product page, and test them. The results show which items cost the most time, so we fix those first rather than chasing small gains.

The Basic package handles images and the biggest problems on a few key pages, with before and after scores. The Standard package covers more pages, improves font loading, flags unused scripts and apps and trims or replaces a few slow ones. The Premium package goes deep into theme code, delays third party scripts where safe, applies mobile first fixes and ends with a re-test and a speed report.

Where a fix could change the look of your store, we send a preview first. We do not change your hosting. Add-ons include testing more pages, cleaning your image library and slimming fonts and icons.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Upload images at a sensible size before adding them to the store.
- Remove apps you no longer use, and their leftover code.
- Test on a real phone with mobile data.
- Re-test after installing any new app.
- Keep a short list of the apps that are truly needed.

**Avoid:**
- Chasing a perfect score at the expense of features that sell.
- Adding auto-playing video to the top of the home page.
- Installing a new app for every small request.
- Loading many font families and weights.
- Judging speed from one test on one day.

## Who this service is for

A store whose pages feel slow on a phone will see the difference most. A seller with many installed apps may not know which ones cost time. A shop that has run ads to a slow landing page can fix the page before spending more.

It also suits owners preparing for a busy season who want the store lighter before traffic rises.

## What we need from you

Send your store address and name the pages you care most about. Tell us which apps matter and which are safe to question. We work as a collaborator, staff or developer user in your store, and we never ask for your password. We take a backup of the theme before making any change.
